item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 25/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. High temperatures will be alleviated slightly over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to southern China midweek this week. The trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the vicinity of the northern part of the South China Sea in the latter part of this week. There will still be a few showers over the region.

Temp range: 24 - 29 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
